items.title: How Will MercadoLibre Stock React To Its Upcoming Earnings?
items.summary: MercadoLibre (NASDAQ:MELI) is scheduled to report its earnings on Wednesday, November 4, 2026. The company has a market value of about $85.0 billion. Over the last twelve months, it generated $35.2 billion in revenue and $2.9 billion in operating profit, with net income of $1.9 billion.

items.title: EBAY Q3 deep dive: broad-based growth, strategic investments, and AI drive marketplace momentum
items.summary: Online marketplace eBay (NASDAQ:EBAY) beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q3 2026, with sales up 13.7% year on year to $3.21 billion. The company expects next quarter’s revenue to be around $3.22 billion, close to analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.51 per share was 6.7% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: Shakeup at Old Navy continues amid merchandising struggles

items.title: eBay, Inc. Generates Strong FCF, But is EBAY Stock at a Peak?
items.summary: eBay, Inc. delivered strong revenue and significantly higher FCF and FCF margins. But EBAY stock is at a peak, so can it still move higher? Maybe, but analysts don't believe so. One play is to short OTM puts.
